question: Will Donald Trump Announce an Annexation of Greenland on July 21, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Donald Trump made a formal, official public announcement on July 21, 2026 (UTC) declaring the annexation of Greenland by the United States — such as a signed executive order, presidential proclamation, or equivalent official White House statement explicitly annexing Greenland.
- "No": Wins if no such formal, official annexation announcement was made by Donald Trump on July 21, 2026 (UTC). Statements of intent, threats, rhetorical claims, social media posts, or informal remarks do not qualify as an annexation announcement.

Clarifications:
- An "annexation announcement" requires an official, legally operative declaration (e.g., executive order, presidential proclamation, or formal White House statement) explicitly annexing or claiming U.S. sovereignty over Greenland. Expressions of desire, negotiation frameworks, or informal comments do not meet this threshold.
